notes: API aggregators / inference gateways (unified model APIs), not AI tool directories. Fees and model catalogs change often — verify on each source.

markets.name: OpenRouter
markets.focus: Unified multi-provider LLM API router (600+ models)
markets.fee_note: No markup on provider list inference. Platform fee on credit purchases: Standard 5.5% (min applied per FAQ); Business 8%; Enterprise discounts. BYOK: $25k/mo list-price inference free on Standard/Business, then 5%. Free tier: 25+ free models, 50 req/day (1k/day after $10 credits).
markets.models_note: 600+ models / 80+ providers on paid plans; 25+ free models / 4 free providers on Free. Auto-routing and preferred vendor on paid plans.

markets.name: OpenCode (Go)
markets.focus: Terminal coding agent + Console Go subscription for curated open-weight model access
markets.fee_note: Go $10/mo, Go Plus $40/mo, Go Teams from ~$20/member/mo for usage allowances on curated models (top-up credits / Extra Usage if needed). Not a raw per-token pass-through catalog like OpenRouter.
markets.models_note: Curated agentic models (e.g. Kimi K3 / K3.1 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Pro / V4.1 Flash, Hy4, GLM-5.3-Flash, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, MiMo-V2.6-Flash, Qwen3.7 Plus, GPT 6 Luna, Claude Haiku 5.5, Muse Spark 1.3) with monthly allowance tables on pricing page (~31 models).

markets.name: Together AI
markets.focus: Serverless + dedicated inference for open and partner models
markets.fee_note: Pay-per-token serverless rates by model on pricing page; dedicated GPUs billed hourly. Start free / scale on demand — verify live model table before quoting.
markets.models_note: Broad open-weight + frontier hosted catalog; OpenAI-compatible APIs (serverless inference, fine-tuning, GPU clusters).

markets.name: Fireworks AI
markets.focus: Production serverless inference with Standard/Priority/Batch/Spot modes
markets.fee_note: Prepaid credits; serverless from ~$0.05/1M input on highlighted models. Cached input often ≤50% of input (no write fee); Standard/Priority/Fast/Batch/Spot modes. Batch 50% off; Spot ~30% off Standard on select models.
markets.models_note: Open + frontier serverless catalog (Kimi K3, Qwen 3.8 Max, GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, MiniMax M3, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, Muse Spark Open, etc.).

markets.name: Groq
markets.fee_note: Pay-as-you-go token pricing by model on GroqCloud (public marketing page is high-level — verify exact $/1M in console/docs). Optimized for speed rather than cheapest $/token.
markets.models_note: Selected open models on GroqCloud; OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

markets.name: DeepInfra
markets.focus: Low-cost serverless inference across many open models
markets.fee_note: Per-model $/1M input & output on pricing page; often undercuts lab list on open weights. Standard / Priority (1.5×) / Flex (0.8×) service tiers. GPU rentals also available.
markets.models_note: Large catalog (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, Llama, Gemma, Gemini/Claude hosted rows, etc.).

markets.name: Novita AI
markets.focus: Budget Model APIs + GPU / serverless endpoints
markets.fee_note: Model API token rates on pricing page; batch inference introductory discounts for supported models. GPU resources billed separately.
markets.models_note: Serverless model endpoints (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, MiMo, etc.) plus dedicated/GPU options.

markets.name: SiliconFlow
markets.focus: CN/global GenAI cloud — LLMs, image, video, speech APIs
markets.fee_note: Pay-as-you-go model APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible). Exact $/¥ rates are in console model list — public intro docs do not list full token tables; verify before quoting.
markets.models_note: Broad multimodal model catalog via SiliconFlow / cloud.siliconflow.com.

markets.name: Gumroad
markets.focus: Digital products / indie SaaS checkout (not an LLM gateway)
markets.fee_note: 10% + $0.50 per direct sale; 30% via Discover. Kept as seller channel, not an API aggregator.
